austin.summary: Austin, drafting 5th you lost two early — Jenna out 4th, Linnea out 6th — and yet here you sit at rank 3 of 5 with 38 counted points, because your back half is pure muscle. Carter and Eric are tied at the very top of the board, 2 of 4 still in the game. Draft GPA 2, but Ep 3 gave you +8 and Ep 6 only +2. The leader has 56. Thirty-four points still on the table.

bullets.label: Carrying the load
bullets.text: Eric, your pick #16 steal, sits at 14 pts and rank 1 of 21 — a mental health counselor reading the room better than anyone out there.

bullets.label: Cause for concern
bullets.text: Jenna at pick #6 was the reach, going out 4th with 4 pts and a rank of 17 of 21, and Linnea's F grade right behind her left you digging out early.

bullets.label: Watch for
bullets.text: Carter and Eric are both on Tovuto and both at 14 pts — if that tribe holds together, those 34 remaining points are yours to chase.

kylie.summary: Kylie, you drafted 3rd and the game hit you first — Aaliyah went home in Episode 1, and you own the First Blood badge for it. Brutal start, 2.25 draft GPA, rank 4 of 5 with 32 counted points, and you're eliminated from contention with the leader sitting on 56. But here's the thing: Cristian at pick #8 ranks 1 of 21. Twenty-two points still on the table. Keep watching.

bullets.label: Carrying the load
bullets.text: Cristian — your pick #8 steal — is the number one scorer in the entire draft pool at 14 pts, rank 1 of 21, and he's still in the game.

bullets.label: Cause for concern
bullets.text: Aaliyah at pick #3 was the reach that stung twice, going out 1st in Episode 1 with 0 pts and a rank of 21 of 21.

bullets.label: Watch for
bullets.text: With 1 of 4 left and 22 points still on the table, every move Cristian makes is your whole scoreboard now — your best week was Ep 7 at +8, so he's shown he can spike.

tami.summary: Tami, you had the first pick in the snake and you built a Tovuto fortress — Jelly, Mike, and Sharonda all sitting at 14 pts, all ranked 1 of 21. That's 45 counted points, rank 2 of 5, with 3 of 5 still in the game and 46 points still on the table while the leader sits at 56. Ep 7 gave you +12. You're not chasing — you're hunting.

bullets.label: Carrying the load
bullets.text: Sharonda Cox, your leftover at pick #21, is tied at the very top with 14 pts and a grade of A — the steal of this entire draft.

bullets.label: Cause for concern
bullets.text: Patt at pick #10 was the reach, going out 3rd in Ep 3 with 3 pts and an F, while Rob's 2 pts get dropped under the best-4 rule — and that 2.4 draft GPA tells the story.

bullets.label: Watch for
bullets.text: Your roster already owns 2 necklaces and 2 idols and advantages found — keep an eye on whether that Immunity Hoarder and Idol Whisperer hardware keeps stacking as the merge grind continues.

taylor.summary: Taylor, you drafted second and built a roster with personality to burn — a crisis manager, a hustler, a voice actress, a pro wrestler — and the torches came fast. You sit 5th of 5 with 31 counted points, 0 of 4 still in the game, 0 points still on the table, and the leader at 56. Draft GPA: 1.25. But hey — Torch Collector with 4 snuffed and Idol Whisperer with 2 found? That's a loud, memorable team.

bullets.label: Carrying the load
bullets.text: Kristin Flickinger led your crew with 12 pts, ranking 12 of 21, and she lasted long enough to become a jury member.

bullets.label: Cause for concern
bullets.text: Ana Sani went out 2nd (Ep 2) and finished with 1 pts, 20th of 21 — that's a tough return on pick #12.

bullets.label: Watch for
bullets.text: Brady Booker was your steal at pick #19 and graded out an A at rank 13 — keep an eye on how that value pick stacks up against the rest of the family's late-round swings.

tim.summary: Tim, you drafted 4th and somehow walked away with an entire tribe intact — four for four, still in the game, rank 1 of 5 with 56 counted points. A 3.75 draft GPA, Untouchable, Merge Machine, Wire-to-Wire, Idol Whisperer. Eleven boots have come and gone and not one of them was yours. You opened quietly at Ep 1 with +4, then detonated in Ep 7 with +16. That, my friend, is a draft.

bullets.label: Carrying the load
bullets.text: There's no single hero here — Lewis, Maggie, Devin and Thien An are each sitting on 14 pts and each ranked 1 of 21, a perfectly balanced four-headed monster.

bullets.label: Cause for concern
bullets.text: Every egg is in the Tovuto basket and Lewis carries the only B grade on the sheet, so any crack in that bloc hits you four ways at once.

bullets.label: Watch for
bullets.text: 58 points are still on the table and the leader has 56 — keep your eyes on that Idol Whisperer badge, because 2 found already means your people are digging.
